cases.sentence: Года два тому назад, в 1808 году, вернувшись в Петербург из своей поездки по имениям, Пьер невольно стал во главе ___.
cases.explain: «петербургского масонства» — after the preposition «во», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Nearly two years before this, in 1808, Pierre on returning to Petersburg after visiting his estates had involuntarily found himself in a leading position among the Petersburg Freemasons. He arranged dining and funeral lodge meetings, enrolled new members, and busied himself uniting various lodges and acquiring authentic charters. He gave money for the erection of temples and supplemented as far as he could the collection of alms, in regard to which the majority of members were stingy and irregular. He supported almost singlehanded a poorhouse the order had founded in Petersburg.

cases.sentence: Он устраивал столовые и ___, вербовал новых членов, заботился о соединении различных лож и о приобретении подлинных актов.
cases.explain: «надгробные ложи» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Nearly two years before this, in 1808, Pierre on returning to Petersburg after visiting his estates had involuntarily found himself in a leading position among the Petersburg Freemasons. He arranged dining and funeral lodge meetings, enrolled new members, and busied himself uniting various lodges and acquiring authentic charters. He gave money for the erection of temples and supplemented as far as he could the collection of alms, in regard to which the majority of members were stingy and irregular. He supported almost singlehanded a poorhouse the order had founded in Petersburg.

cases.sentence: Он любил хорошо пообедать и выпить, и, хотя и считал это безнравственным и унизительным, не мог воздержаться от увеселений ___, в которых он участвовал.
cases.explain: «холостых обществ» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: His life meanwhile continued as before, with the same infatuations and dissipations. He liked to dine and drink well, and though he considered it immoral and humiliating could not resist the temptations of the bachelor circles in which he moved.

cases.sentence: Из под ___ и знаков он видел на них мундиры и кресты, которых они добивались в жизни.
cases.explain: «масонских фартуков» — after the preposition «под», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Osip Alexéevich was not in Petersburg—he had of late stood aside from the affairs of the Petersburg lodges, and lived almost entirely in Moscow. All the members of the lodges were men Pierre knew in ordinary life, and it was difficult for him to regard them merely as Brothers in Freemasonry and not as Prince B. or Iván Vasílevich D., whom he knew in society mostly as weak and insignificant men. Under the Masonic aprons and insignia he saw the uniforms and decorations at which they aimed in ordinary life. Often after collecting alms, and reckoning up twenty to thirty rubles received for the most part in promises from a dozen members, of whom half were as well able to pay as himself, Pierre remembered the Masonic vow in which each Brother promised to devote all his belongings to his neighbor, and doubts on which he tried not to dwell arose in his soul.

cases.sentence: Пьер уважал этот разряд братьев масонов, к которому принадлежали преимущественно ___, и сам Иосиф Алексеевич, по мнению Пьера, но не разделял их интересов.
cases.explain: «старые братья» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He divided the Brothers he knew into four categories. In the first he put those who did not take an active part in the affairs of the lodges or in human affairs, but were exclusively occupied with the mystical science of the order: with questions of the threefold designation of God, the three primordial elements—sulphur, mercury, and salt—or the meaning of the square and all the various figures of the temple of Solomon. Pierre respected this class of Brothers to which the elder ones chiefly belonged, including, Pierre thought, Osip Alexéevich himself, but he did not share their interests. His heart was not in the mystical aspect of Freemasonry.

cases.sentence: Сердце его не лежало к ___ масонства.
cases.explain: «мистической стороне» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: He divided the Brothers he knew into four categories. In the first he put those who did not take an active part in the affairs of the lodges or in human affairs, but were exclusively occupied with the mystical science of the order: with questions of the threefold designation of God, the three primordial elements—sulphur, mercury, and salt—or the meaning of the square and all the various figures of the temple of Solomon. Pierre respected this class of Brothers to which the elder ones chiefly belonged, including, Pierre thought, Osip Alexéevich himself, but he did not share their interests. His heart was not in the mystical aspect of Freemasonry.

cases.sentence: Ко ___ Пьер причислял себя и себе подобных братьев, ищущих, колеблющихся, не нашедших еще в масонстве прямого и понятного пути, но надеющихся найти его.
cases.explain: «второму разряду» — after the preposition «ко», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: In the second category Pierre reckoned himself and others like him, seeking and vacillating, who had not yet found in Freemasonry a straight and comprehensible path, but hoped to do so.

cases.sentence: Таковы были Вилларский и даже ___ главной ложи.
cases.explain: «великий мастер» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: In the third category he included those Brothers (the majority) who saw nothing in Freemasonry but the external forms and ceremonies, and prized the strict performance of these forms without troubling about their purport or significance. Such were Willarski and even the Grand Master of the principal lodge.

cases.sentence: К четвертому разряду, наконец, причислялось тоже ___ братьев, в особенности в последнее время вступивших в братство.
cases.explain: «большое количество» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Finally, to the fourth category also a great many Brothers belonged, particularly those who had lately joined. These according to Pierre’s observations were men who had no belief in anything, nor desire for anything, but joined the Freemasons merely to associate with the wealthy young Brothers who were influential through their connections or rank, and of whom there were very many in the lodge.

cases.sentence: Он и не думал сомневаться в ___, но подозревал, что русское масонство пошло по ложному пути и отклонилось от своего источника.
cases.explain: «самом масонстве» — the prepositional is used only after a preposition, for location or topic.
cases.translation: Pierre began to feel dissatisfied with what he was doing. Freemasonry, at any rate as he saw it here, sometimes seemed to him based merely on externals. He did not think of doubting Freemasonry itself, but suspected that Russian Masonry had taken a wrong path and deviated from its original principles. And so toward the end of the year he went abroad to be initiated into the higher secrets of the order.
